proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 704(1)(c), eaves over required windows must be at least how many millimeters from the side and rear property lines?
proposed.rationale: Section 704(1)(c) requires eaves over required windows to be not less than 750 millimeters from the side and rear property lines. This is a narrow rule: it governs only eaves over required windows on side and rear lines, not all projections or all facades.
proposed.explanation: The 750 mm figure is the only eave clearance stated in Section 704(1)(c). It applies specifically to eaves over required windows and to side and rear property lines; front setbacks remain governed by local zoning and Rule VII Sec. 702-703.
